meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行蛋白质序列建模与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正从事蛋白质相关的生物信息研究
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and analyze sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're doing protein-related bioinformatics research

howto.what: Claude 会按你的要求调用 esm Python SDK：用 ESM3 生成、补全或设计蛋白序列，做结构预测与反向折叠，用 ESMC 计算蛋白嵌入向量，可跑本地权重或经 Forge/Biohub 云端推理。
howto.when: 当你要直接使用 esm Python SDK，或提到 ESM3、ESMC 等模型，以及 Forge/Biohub 推理与 ESMFold2 折叠流程时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 把这段带下划线的序列补全，跑 8 步
say.note: 会调用本地 ESM3 做序列补全并打印结果

say.text: 用 esmc_300m 给这几条蛋白序列算嵌入向量
say.note: 返回序列嵌入，可用于相似度或分类

say.text: 从 target_structure.pdb 反推能折叠成它的序列，温度 0.7
say.note: 走 ESM3 反向折叠生成序列

howto.what_en: Claude uses the esm Python SDK to run ESM3 for protein sequence generation, completion and inverse folding, ESMC for embeddings, with local weights or Forge/Biohub hosted inference.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work directly with the esm Python SDK or ESM3/ESMC model IDs, or use Forge/Biohub inference clients and ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this masked sequence with esm3-open in 8 steps
Get ESMC embeddings for these protein sequences
Inverse-fold target_structure.pdb into a sequence, temperature 0.7
